feed.title: LazyRelay changelog
feed.subtitle: What is actually shipped, in plain language, most recent first.

entry.title: LazyRelay update, October 8, 2026
entry.summary: Updated the code libraries LazyRelay is built on to patched versions that close the security advisories we had open.

entry.title: LazyRelay update, August 10, 2026
entry.summary: Added a "first comment" option to the compose form for Facebook and Instagram, so a follow-up comment (handy for hashtags) posts automatically right after your... | Added a Guides section covering scheduler comparisons, platform coverage, and how several AI features actually work.

entry.title: LazyRelay update, August 8, 2026
entry.summary: Shareable Proof-of-Publish links: turn any verified post into a public link you can send a client, franchise contact, or boss as proof it actually went live. | Optional email alerts the moment a post genuinely fails to publish, instead of only finding out by checking the dashboard. | AI-powered "needs attention" filter for Mentions and DMs, so you can see which comments and DMs are actually worth opening without reading the full list. | A webhook that fires the moment Proof-of-Publish confirms a post is live, for anyone wiring LazyRelay into their own tools. | "Not sure what to post? Get ideas" button in the compose form, generating post ideas grounded in your business and recent posts. | Brand labels for connected accounts, with filtering across every dashboard view, for anyone running more than one business through LazyRelay. | An on-demand AI insight on the Analytics tab comparing your best- and worst-performing posts.

entry.title: LazyRelay update, August 7, 2026
entry.summary: Real engagement analytics (likes, comments, shares, views), not just post counts. | Comments inbox extended to Facebook and Instagram, with reply capability added across Facebook, Instagram, Mastodon, and Bluesky. | DM inbox for Facebook and Instagram. | DM automation: automatically send a DM to anyone who comments a specific keyword. | A public API and MCP server, plus a documentation page, for anyone who wants to schedule and manage posts programmatically or through an AI agent.

entry.title: LazyRelay update, August 6, 2026
entry.summary: Threads posting confirmed live end to end. | Tumblr connected as a supported platform. | Added a "Disconnect" button for connected accounts. | Fixed a bug where a post's status sometimes didn't refresh automatically on the Overview tab. | Redesigned the Overview page with real charts instead of a plain list.

entry.title: LazyRelay update, July 31, 2026
entry.summary: Analytics dashboard, Phase 1: total posts, per-platform success rates, and a daily volume trend. | Visual content calendar (month view). | Bulk CSV import: schedule up to 200 posts at once, with a per-row preview before importing. | AI caption generator. | Best-time-to-post suggestions, honestly labeled as general guidance, not personalized. | Approval workflow: mark a post as needing sign-off before it goes out. | AI hashtag suggestions. | Link-in-bio page. | Read-only comment tracking for YouTube, Mastodon, and Bluesky. | Browser extension for scheduling a page, link, or image directly from wherever you find it.
